title: Tech Note: Custom Sequence Number
author: Kristopher Merolla, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Semaphores and transaction control (including transaction suspension) remain current, supported 4D concurrency mechanisms, so this technique for building a race-condition-safe custom sequence number is still fully valid and used today. This is a timeless multi-user database concurrency pattern unaffected by 4D's ORDA or Project Mode transitions, since sequence generation logic sits below both.
related_updates: Semaphores and transaction commands remain part of current 4D
The built-in Sequence number function referenced still exists as an alternative for simpler cases
Pattern is equally applicable whether records are created via classic commands or ORDA entities
